text: A dark grey benchtop rack or rotator sits on a white surface against a pale wall. It has an upright end plate on the left and a horizontal bar running right, fitted with a row of about eight round black holder rings arranged in two staggered lines. A single conical centrifuge tube is held upright in one of the central rings, passing through the bar. The tube is uncapped, its lid open and tilted back at the top, and it is filled roughly two-thirds with a red-pink liquid; graduation marks are visible along its side, and the pointed tip hangs below the bar. A white label with a black square symbol is mounted on the right end. A teal and white control panel is on the base below.
